products.title: Fundamentals of Jiu-Jitsu: Introduction To Meregali’s Gi System by Nicholas Meregali
products.body:
Fundamentals of Jiu-Jitsu: Introduction To Meregali’s Gi System by Nicholas Meregali will change your gi game - Widely considered the greatest gi competitor in the world, his easy to use program is made for anyone with a basics to advanced approach - his approach to guard is science 

  • Meregali is one of the most accomplished competitors in the history of the sport having earned multiple IBJJF world titles!
  • Upgrade your bottom game with battle tested systems Nicholas has used at the highest levels of competition, including strategies from open guard, x-guard, single leg x, and collar/pant control!
  • Develop non stop passing pressure with next-level toreando passes that will leave guards in the dust!
  • Dominate from the top with easy-to-follow guides on how to flatten opponents for effective half guard passing as well as securing and stabilizing from the mount.
  • Discover crippling controls from the mount that expose high percentage submissions!
  • Meregali has one of the highest finishing percentages in the sport, and now you can learn his secrets to success for securing chokes from the back!
  • Revolutionize Your Gi Game With Winning Strategies From Both Bottom and Top Positions With Legendary Jiu-Jitsu Competitor Nicholas Meregali!


 Check Out a Free Technique!

What Will You Learn? 

This instructional is dedicated to a high level introduction of Meregali's game. Nicholas has an extremely unique game that is clearly working better than anyone else's at the highest level of the sport. 

With a modern approach to BJJ that still emphasizes the basics and fundamentals, he has absolutely beautiful BJJ. The misconception with his game, is that it is complex. This is because he beats world champions and ADCC champs so easily.

The truth is, Nicholas has a unique approach to fundamental BJJ mixed with modern BJJ. It is not difficult and in this basics to advanced approach you will see just how easy it is to use his style.

Who Is This For?

This series is for anyone at any level. Regardless of if you're a white belt or black belt, there is much to learn from Nicholas. His approach to BJJ is the future of the sport. Simplifying high level fundamentals into easy to implement concepts. That is the backbone of this instructional video.

Nicholas is going to walk you through his gi system and show you exactly how to start using these positions immediately. 

So, What Exactly Do You Get?

PART 1

  • INTRO
  • OVERVIEW
  • COLLAR AND PANT CONTROL

PART 2

  • TOP HALF GUARD
  • MOUNT

PART 3

  • SINGLE LEG X / X-GUARD RETENTION
  • STRANGLE FROM THE BACK

PART 4

  • TOREANDO PASSING APPROACH
  • OUTRO

This series is perfect for anyone that wants to develop a devastating open guard. A guard that will work on anyone and use the highest level of fundamentals to control opponents regardless of their weight or size. 

Nicholas has a unique teaching ability and there are no prerequisites to being able to use this system. Whether you're short, tall, big, small, white belt, or black belt, there is something here for EVERYONE!

products.title: Fundamentals Of Jiu-Jitsu: Half Guard Pressure Passing by Nicholas Meregali
products.body:
Rapidly Increase Your Passing Percentage Against High-Level Opponents With BJJ Phenom Nicholas Meregali and His Fundamentals For Half Guard Passing! Meregali has QUICKLY become the best BJJ athlete in the world and his instructional videos showcase EXACTLY how that happened 

  • Nicholas Meregali is one of the most accomplished BJJ competitors in the sport, with one of the highest finishing rates among top tier athletes consistently using his top pressure system as seen in the instructional
  • Dive into granular detail on how to dismantle any half guard and open up not only passing opportunity, but submissions as well
  • Learn to systematically flatten the hips, flatten the shoulders, build heavy athletic posture, defeat frames, dismantle knee shields, and more!
  • Demoralize opponents from top half with world class details on positioning, body control, and utilizing constricting cross face techniques that work effortlessly at the HIGHEST LEVEL
  • Never struggle with the knee shield again by utilizing Meregali’s game-changing strategy for consistently removing the knee shield, and earn a huge advantage over savvy half guard players.
  • Exhaust opponents with the belt camping concept that forces them to carry your weight to the point where they basically GIVE you the pass!
  • Build a robust submission system from the top with Meregali’s favorite top half submission series.
  • Fundamentals Of Jiu-Jitsu: Half Guard Pressure Passing is a 3 -part masterclass from BJJ Superstar Nicholas Meregali that will drastically improve your approach and ability to dominate the half guard!


Check Out a Free Technique!

Why Learn From Nicholas? 

Nicholas has a unique style of top passing. He is able to to utilize modern day standing passes and connect that style to his pressure systems. This series is all about getting to areas where he able to apply the most devastating pressure using simple fundamental movements. 

Training with John Danaher now, Nicholas has been able to simplify his approach to BJJ EVEN MORE. He has taken positions that many people consider advanced and simplified them so white belts can learn them too. 

His Fundamentals Of Jiu-Jitsu: Half Guard Pressure Passing is truly a unique approach to using top pressure, although the instructional is filmed in his Gi, Nicholas uses a lot of close pressure passing that is versatile and effective in both gi and no gi. Focusing on the half guard, this instructional can easily be used by no gi practitioners as well. 

Who Is This Instructional For?

This instructional video is for anybody of any level. While the advanced practitioners may understand more of the underlying concepts and application, the lower belts will also benefit from the precise detail that Nicholas uses to demonstrate the technique. 

This instructional video is intended to have a "basics to advanced" approach and help anyone start to pass guard.  Nicholas has a perfect balance of flow and pressure and this pressure system is one of the most technical application of pressure in a video you can get. 

What Are People Saying?
